newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mobil sees deal to consider Gorgon-NWS merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mobil sees deal to consider Gorgon-NWS merger.

text.p: Mobil Corp on Tuesday said it expected the owners of Australia's Gorgon offshore gas field to sign an agreement by the end of June to look at merging the field's development with the giant North West Shelf project.
Mobil's Australian unit, Mobil Australia, said three of the Gorgon field's four joint venturers had signed a "cooperative development" protocol, including Mobil.
The Gorgon partners are Mobil, with a one-seventh stake, and Texaco, Chevron Inc and Royal Dutch/Shell Group, each with a two-sevenths stake.
"We are hopeful that (a protocol) will happen before the end of the month," Mobil Australia's general manager of corporate affairs, David Byers, told Reuters.

"There's been a protocol which has been developed...it's between the four partners. Three have signed off on the protocol, and we are one of them, and I obviously can't say who the fourth party is (that has not signed)."
